name: Nonoichi Subaru
source:
A naive chick with a cute smile. 
An athletic girl, her body seems to always be in motion. 
She can’t get enough of her senpai Satomi and is always showing up at the office to follow her around. 
On the other hand, she sees our hero as a rival for Satomi’s affection and often tries to punish him with head and leglocks. 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=187]MangaGamer[/url]]
